title: 流程步骤标签：nodes/screens 按语言精确键读取，zh-cn 会话读不到 zh-CN 的翻译
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named site, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7119075936). Source: L1 record 7119060969 on PR #36803 (#36633). That PR did not introduce it.

## What happens

`ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts` `flowLabelTranslations` reads the step labels with `bundle[language]?.flows?.[flowName]` (line 74 on `origin/main`), so the `nodes.<id>.label` and `screens.<id>.title` reads index the bundle by the exact language key. A session whose language is `zh-cn` misses a bundle keyed `zh-CN`, and the console shows the authored step label instead of the translation. PR #36803 moves only the `approvals` step-label read onto the locale-normalising resolver (`resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel`). The `nodes` and `screens` reads keep the exact key.

reach: read from the code, not run in a browser. It applies to any session whose language tag differs from the bundle key only by case or form.

## Expected

The `nodes` and `screens` step-label reads resolve the locale the same way the flow label (`translateFlow`) and, after #36803, the approvals step label do. A `zh-cn` session reads a `zh-CN` row.

## Acceptance

- A pin with a `zh-CN` bundle and a `zh-cn` session, for a plain node label and for an untitled screen's title.
- The exact-key case still reads as today.

Dedupe: open issues for `flowLabels` and `activeFlowsBundle` return only #36633, which is in flight and covers the approvals read alone.
